mainEntity.name: How much does AI Website Optimization for AEO cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI Website Optimization for AEO varies depending on several factors, including the size and complexity of your website, the volume of content needing optimization, and the specific goals your business aims to achieve. Pricing models can range from project-based fees for initial setup and optimization to ongoing monthly retainers for continuous monitoring and updates. A detailed proposal is provided after an initial assessment of your current website and AEO needs, outlining the scope and investment required.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for AI Website Optimization vary based on website size, content volume, and business goals, typically ranging from project-based fees to ongoing retainers after an initial assessment.
